purpose: Verify selected attached ATTRIB fields and SEQEND presence through generated nested INSERT DXF readback into the headless consumer.
changes: Attached one runtime-authored ATTRIB to the nested parent INSERT and retained an explicit SEQEND object.
Checked attribute count, tag/text, elevated insertion point, extrusion, height, rotation, width scale, oblique angle, flags, field length, lock-position, style, and sequence-end presence.
Repeated assertions for AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXF readback under ext=false and ext=true.
scopeLimit: Same-library DXF callback transport only. No independent ATTRIB interoperability, DWG ownership/handle semantics, text placement, or native rendering is established.
fixturePolicy: DXF files are generated under a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture was added.
